## About

Rohit Pathak is a Technical Product Manager focused on complex industrial and capital-project environments, shipping Gen AI into real operations. He has worked at Hexagon AB and Nestlé and is based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

## Selected work

- Structra — vision-based defect detection from inspection photos
- Volve Field RAG Explorer — multi-source RAG on the Volve field dataset
- AutoSignal — NHTSA-backed vehicle research (TSBs, recalls, complaints in plain language)
- AI Agents & NL Querying — natural-language agents over operational / subsurface data
- Enterprise AI Copilot System — LLM-based agents for complex 3D engineering workflows

## How to interview him online

Use rohit.agent on the home page (https://www.rohitpathak.com/#interview). It retrieves from his CV, case studies, and interview corpus. Fair game: work history, availability, notice period, failures, how he builds products.
